candidate.title: Multi-View Reconstruction
candidate.subtitle: Reconstructing structure from incomplete views
candidate.question: Can several incomplete registered views recover a declared relation state while preserving what remains unknown?
candidate.supported_finding: Registered three-view alignment recovers the declared relation state while retaining source ambiguity.
candidate.conformance_exception: Q_C is preregistered as (b2,b3) and implemented as (b1,b3); the implementation passes, but the original preregistration is not claimed conformant.
candidate.claim_ceiling: Bounded finite reconstruction, abstention, GLB custody and internal navigation only; no full source recovery, historical OIL/RIS semantics, physical mechanism, public admission or validated external utility.
candidate.admission_gate: One independent reviewer completes the four-question Human Return and the response, time, uncertainty and confusions are recorded.
